cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've planned lunch for us at one. Move the haircut; your oldest friend gets that slot today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've had that appointment for weeks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I've had you since school. You choose where we eat; I just want to know I can outrank a trim.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Changing it today costs twenty pounds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cover that. A proper friendship budget. You pick lunch, I'll follow your lead. Just cross out the haircut and write my name in its place while I'm here.

reason: Ground confident scheduling in the friendship claim, then concede cost and lunch control while preserving the exact rearrangement as proof.
